gen-dafont-bloody-gf-sono: Bloody swells its lowercase into fat, round bowls with a commanding growl, while Sono spaces itself wide, its a's left ajar. Bloody earns its keep large and in short bursts.
gen-dafont-bloody-gf-stack-sans-headline: Fat, rounded lowercase bowls give Bloody a bloody, commanding swagger, while Stack Sans Headline keeps a single-weight skeleton with wide gaps. The shouting sits up top and the steady line carries the text below.
gen-dafont-bloody-gf-stack-sans-notch: Bloody's rounded, swollen lowercase gives it a commanding, bloody look. Stack Sans Notch then runs open-curved and rod-straight, so paragraphs of sans-serif text feel steady and easy on the eye.
gen-dafont-bloody-gf-stack-sans-text: Bloody swaggers in with fat, rounded lowercase, then hands the page to Stack Sans Text and its constant, marker-like line. Paragraphs move along smoothly, with curve endings held well apart.
gen-dafont-bloody-gf-sulphur-point: Sulphur Point draws a marker-like line with bulky lowercase, a quiet foil to Bloody's commanding heft. And across a full page of text its open gaps keep each word legible, with no thin strokes to fade.
gen-dafont-bloody-gf-yaldevi: Loud and round: Bloody brings the commanding bulk, while Yaldevi offers an e that opens clearly to the right and outsized lowercase. Headline growl above, spacious reading text below.
gen-dafont-bushcraft-gf-aldrich: Expressive and widely spaced, Bushcraft draws each curve without any shift in weight, its capitals barely rising above the lowercase. Aldrich opens its round letters like cupped hands, so a long paragraph reads smoothly.
gen-dafont-bushcraft-gf-alexandria: Flat and graphic: Bushcraft sets single-weight letters, closed and spread wide, beside Alexandria's open c terminals and short stems above and below. Closed against open is the pair's whole argument.
gen-dafont-bushcraft-gf-amiko: Amiko reads sturdy and modern, its terminals flaring outward like a pair of tongs. But Bushcraft is at its best spread wide and expressive, while Amiko is at its best carrying lowercase text.
gen-dafont-bushcraft-gf-anek-devanagari: Artistic Bushcraft looks drawn with one nib, spaced wide. Anek Devanagari opens its letter mouths distinctly while the heading stays closed, and that closed-versus-open tension is the pair's real hook.
